quantifiers: all finite fields and all convergent asymptotic field sequences
proof_type: exact continuous change of variables and compactness/approximation argument
conclusion: The formula extends continuously to [0,1]^4. Every unbounded field sequence has a compact-x convergent subsequence; conversely every closed-cube point is approached by finite fields using x_k^(n)=max(x_k,1/n). Therefore its image is exactly the probability-law closure of the full nonnegative four-field family.
